Specification: Synod consensus specification: Defines consensus over N processes with a set of Inputs. The outer module declares constants and variables, with an inner submodule Inner that models consensus dynamics. IChoose lets a process output an agreed value; IFail lets a process fail and re-input. The Inner module's ISpec is the temporal specification, and the outer module's SynodSpec uses temporal existential quantification (\EE) over chosen and allInput.
IfThenElse: IF chosen = NotAnInput THEN \E ip \in allInput : /\ chosen' = ip /\ output' = [output EXCEPT ![p] = ip] ELSE /\ output' = [output EXCEPT ![p] = chosen] /\ UNCHANGED chosen
DivisionNotes: Synod has an outer Synod module and an inner submodule Inner. Both are unified here at the top level: outer defines Proc, NotAnInput, IS, SynodSpec; Inner defines IInit, IChoose, IFail, INext, ISpec.

ActionDefNames=[IChoose, IFail, INext] (contain primed variables); OperatorDefNames_TemporalProperty=[ISpec, SynodSpec] (ISpec uses [][INext]_vars; SynodSpec uses \EE temporal existential quantification); OperatorDefNames_Init=[IInit]; OperatorDefNames_ValueDef=[Proc, NotAnInput, IS].
TemporalNesting=false: ISpec uses only a single outer [] around an action subscript; SynodSpec wraps with \EE; no temporal operator nested inside another.
